# XZ Embedded

Upstream: https://github.com/tukaani-project/xz-embedded

Revision: `ae63ae3a36ed01724674e8f3d750dc47bf125410`

License: 0BSD; see [`COPYING`](../../oss/xz-embedded/COPYING). Source files are unmodified, copied from
